payload.answer: The reports-worker deployment in proofix-case-04 was unschedulable because its pod template specified an incorrect nodeSelector (disk=nvme) and lacked the toleration for the dedicated=reports:NoSchedule taint on the intended node node1. The deployment was patched to select storage=nvme and add the narrow dedicated=reports:NoSchedule toleration, allowing the rollout to finish successfully.

Node node1 is labeled storage=nvme, tainted with dedicated=reports:NoSchedule, and has sufficient allocatable resources.
The reports-worker deployment was patched and successfully completed rollout on the intended node.
